_comment: R5-at-scale campaign. Each hole is a single-hole def-shell scaffold; N forced-diverse agents (distinct model families) each fill the ONE hole into an isolated checkout --multi scratch; diverge-report classifies observational divergence over Omega. Design is a 2-axis grid: contract tightness {loose, tight, intentional} x composition {self-contained, helper-composing}. Measures per hole over R repeats: under-constraint-witness RATE (Wilson 95% CI), convergence rate (tight holes), sibling-suppression incidence (should be 0 for def-shell after v0.14.9), spurious-witness soundness (a witness needs >=2 fills that BOTH verify against the real solver, so it cannot be manufactured). Requires llmll >= 0.14.9 (sibling-call classification fix) -- a stale binary false-nulls the helper-composing holes.
_design: loose/self-contained: clamp_weak, abs_nonneg, range_mid. tight/self-contained: clamp_tight(dec), id_tight, double_tight. intentional: clamp_intentional. loose/helper-composing: transfer_helper, clamp_via_helper. tight/helper-composing: transfer_tight.
_cmd_note: agy replaced the gemini CLI (Antigravity); --model takes the display string from `agy models`. codex gpt-5.5 uses bare `codex exec` (no --model) on ChatGPT-tier. claude model id is claude-opus-4-8. The {DIR} token in each cmd is replaced by run_multi.py with the agent's absolute working dir, so the prompt names an absolute AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md path (avoids the flaky 'file not found' when a CLI does not honour cwd for file search). Confirm each CLI is logged in; use --mock first (zero spend).

agents.name: claude-opus-4-8
agents.cmd: claude -p --dangerously-skip-permissions --model claude-opus-4-8 'Read {DIR}/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and complete the task.'

agents.name: gpt-5.5
agents.cmd: codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox 'Read {DIR}/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and complete the task.'

agents.name: gemini-3.1-pro
agents.cmd: agy -p 'Read {DIR}/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and complete the task.' --model 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)' --dangerously-skip-permissions
